notes.title: v1.1.2: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixing a bug where moving platforms could get stuck in player enclosures at the start of the match, leading to them being desynced with other moving platforms.

notes.title: v1.1.1: Single Player Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Now tracking "no damage runs" for all single player levels.  Can you complete these challenging levels without getting hit?
[list]
[*] These are tracked separately from best time, so you don't need to complete both in the same run!
[/list]
[*] Adding dev best times to all Single Player levels.  Can you beat my best times?
[*] Made some slight tweaks to a few single player levels to make difficult areas a bit easier.
[*] Updating the Lightbender's Prism relic to make the player a bit more invisible.
[*] Fixing a bug caused by unplugging a controller during single player and then restarting the level.
[*] Updating the visuals on the Windstrider Boots relic to look more like a speed trail.
[*] Making falling stalactite projectiles cancel grappling hooks.
[*] Fixing a bug where dead players could get stuck in reforming crumble platforms.
[*] Fixing a bug where the flame spitter SFX could persist after progressing to a different room.
[*] Fixing a bug where dead bodies could go crazy at extreme frame rates.
[*] Updating credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Single Player Update!
notes.notes:
One of the most requested features for the game has been a single player mode, so I decided I'd add not one, but [b]four[/b] single player mini-modes!  Play as your favorite character as you race against the clock to master relics, prove your platforming prowess, amass treasure, and reclaim stolen relics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974750/9b4492346757ec3094bcdb7ca3fc21034f473e24.png[/img]

[h1]New Single Player Modes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mage: [b]Relic Mastery[/b] - Start with a relic and progress through a (mostly) linear level that's built for that specific relic.
[*] Shadow assassin: [b]Parkour Challenge[/b] - Progress through a (mostly) linear level without a relic.  These levels largely revolve around general platforming skills, dodging traps, and non-grapplable surfaces.
[*] Pirate: [b]Treasure Hunt[/b] - Collect all the coins in a more "normal"/non-linear level.
[*] Tomb Guardian: [b]Relic Recovery[/b] - Chase after the stolen relics and return them to their proper owner.
[/list]
10 challenging levels were added, with more coming in the future!

[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Intrepid explorers have discovered a new relic - Windstrider Boots.  Acquiring this relic will increase your movement speed.
[*]Adding new game changer options for adjusting respawn time, move speed, gravity, and max hearts (Per player), and one to hide player health.
[list]
[*]Since the max hearts Game Changer can be adjusted per-player, this doubles as a handicap option.
[/list]
[*]Adding a new trap: Homing turret.
[*]Adding floating text when gaining/losing relics and picking up coins/diamonds, as well as options to disable these.
[list]
[*]Hopefully this will address concerns over new players not understanding what different relics do.
[/list]
[*]Adding a 3-2-1 countdown timer at the start of matches.
[*]Adding an option to disable displaying the crown for players in the lead.
[*]Adding a coin bar UI element to show player coin progress vs max, as well as an option to disable it.
[list]
[*]The hope is that this provides players a way see who's winning and/or their own progress with a quick glance.
[/list]
[*]Adding an option to disable the player face UI, to allow players to play without info on relics and/or coin progress.
[*]Fixing a bug that caused relics to teleport on the y-axis when a player died while grappling the relic.
[*]Capping the number of coins that can be spawned, just in case.
[*]Fixing an issue where coinsplosion coins could go crazy at low/high frame rates.
[*]Fixing a bug that made the player unable to double jump immediately if they picked up the wings of ascension relic while in the air.
[*]Updating some coin UI, including changing the color of the number of coins to make it easier to see at a glance.
[*]Adjusting how boulders handle rebounding to account for changes to gravity.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.8
notes.notes:
[h1]New Level[/h1]
Intrepid explorers have discovered a new location in the Dunes of Eternity: The Whispering Expanse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974750/2c80cb0c07ab2f83902d14a9aa6d19f118461a4a.png[/img]

[h1]New Relics[/h1]
Intrepid explorers have discovered some new relics:
[list]
[*] Cthulhu's Tendril: Increases your max grapple distance.
[*] Lightbender's Prism: Makes you more difficult to see.
[/list]

[h1]Game Changers[/h1]
Game Changers are new options that, well, change the game - Exploding corpses, exploding grapples, and probably some others that don't involve explosions.  Let me know what you think or if you have ideas for new game changers you'd like to see!

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adding Game Changers in the Match Options menu: Exploding corpses, coinsplosion corpses, exploding grapples, and number of relics to start with.
[*] Adding an option to increase/decrease the max grapple length.
[*] Adding a special heart sprite for the Lifeblood Gem relic and making the player lose that heart when it's removed.
[*] Reordering levels based on difficulty so it's more intuitive for new players.
[*] Reduced turret traps' danger level across basically all aspects (Though watch out, they still remain one of the more dangerous traps!).
[*] Making coin runes create a small coinsplosion when hit (In addition to making all existing coins fall).
[*] Making the dart trap laser line alpha in over time to make it more clear what's happening and that the "laser" isn't dangerous by itself.
[*] Making dart traps start on cooldown.
[*] Adding a crown on the UI for the player(s) in the lead.
[*] Fixing a bug where the explosive rune's damage zone would linger even when the sprite looked like it should no longer deal damage.
[*] Changing the color of the plant turret head based on the player that spawned it and removing the outline shader from it.
[*] Updating the dead body/bear trap interaction to seem more intentional and less like a bug.
[*] Updating the collision shape and size on runes to make them easier to hit.
[*] Adding an effect to portals to help keep track of the character that's teleporting.
[*] Making crumble platforms shake a big when crumbling to make them more noticeable.
[*] Making the boulder warning icon (Option) show up on first boulder drop.  Previously, the first instance was skipped.
[*] Making the match UI display while on the pause menu.
[*] Updating controller button sprites.
[*] Updating character select buttons to display input using the controller the player is using.
[*] Adding held scroll functionality to the Options menu.
[*] Automatically pausing the game if a controller is unplugged during a match.
[*] Fixing a bug where the readable font was drawing at the wrong position.
[*] Potentially fixing an issue where rumble could get stuck on.
[/list]

notes.title: One Month Recap
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  Now that we're a month post-launch and things have mostly stabilized, I thought I'd recap the updates that have gone into the game and all the exciting things that have happened.  Let's dive in!

[h1]Discord Community[/h1]
https://discord.gg/gPSQvZ24vv

We've got a Discord community now!  Join to get updates or give feedback on the game, learn about game dev tips and tricks, or just hang out and talk about games.

[h1]Game Updates Since Launch[/h1]
I've done my best to put in constant game updates while juggling things like marketing and social media, applying for game festivals, and doing non-game work like building a Discord community.  Here are some of the updates I've put into the game:
[list]
[*] 5 new levels.
[*] ~30 achievements.
[*] Game improvements like improved coinsplosions, grappling hook indicators, and VFX trails for the player in the lead.
[*] New game options, like adjusting the coin spawn speed and big head mode.
[*] Lots of polish and bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1]News and Game Coverage[/h1]
I can't talk about the details yet, but in addition to the notes below, there's some big upcoming news regarding game festivals - Stay tuned!
[list]
[*] Streamed by Stumpt and Glint Gamers on Twitch.
[*] Reviews from IndieGames.eu and CSH Picone.
[*] 15k views on Reddit AMA.
[*] Responses from creators that were very influential to me, including Mark Brown (Game Maker's Toolkit), Sara Spalding, and PixelatedPope.
[*] Got 10 positive reviews within the first week! (I can't thank y'all enough for this!)
[/list]

[h1]Potential Future Updates[/h1]
I have more ideas for updates than I know what to do with - Let me know which update you're most excited for and I'll prioritize the ones with the most votes!
[list]
[*] Practice AI opponents.
[*] Single player mode: Parkour challenge rooms that save your best time.
[*] Single player mode: Roguelike to escape with as much treasure as you can before dying.
[*] More levels/biomes, options, relics, platform types, and/or traps.
[list]
[*] Options examples: Exploding corpses, disable each trap individually, or balancing options such as increased health or damage on a per-player basis.
[*] Relic examples: Invisibility, freeze other players, periodically leave behind a void that damages other players.
[*] Platform type examples: Platforms that can be grappled onto but don't stop movement (Or vice versa), paired platforms that switch which one's active, platforms that are only visible if a player is nearby.
[*] Trap examples: Springs that shoot players in a direction, electric net that snatches relics if you pass through it, gravity zones/black holes.
[/list]
[*] Multiplayer mode: CTF.
[*] Multiplayer mode: Timed mode.
[*] Multiplayer mode: Win by gaining relics instead of coins.
[/list]

Not bad for just one month!  Thank you to anyone that has supported the game in any way - By buying or playing the game, writing a review or streaming it, sharing info about it on social media, providing feedback, or anything else.  Your help and support means so much to me!

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out on the Discord or on Steam's Discussions board - I'd love to hear from you!
